en.title: Kingdom Hearts 4: Devs Vow No Delays Past Late 2027 Launch
en.summary: Square Enix leadership has definitively stated that Kingdom Hearts 4 will not face delays beyond its planned late 2027 release window. This assurance comes amidst fan concerns rooted in the series' history of lengthy development cycles.
en.body:
The wait for **Kingdom Hearts 4** might feel like it's stretching into eternity for some, but developers are now drawing a firm line in the sand. At D23 2026, series creator **Tetsuya Nomura** and co-director **Tai Yasue** emphatically addressed speculation about potential delays, promising fans that the game is “100%” on track for its late 2027 launch.

"I want to set the record straight: That is not happening," **Nomura** stated during a panel, directly countering online rumors that suggested the release date might still slip. He emphasized that the marketing push for **Kingdom Hearts 4** is just beginning and urged fans to anticipate further news. **Yasue** echoed this confidence, assuring the audience, "I can confidently say and promise that it will launch in 2027. Schedule-wise, the development is very smooth. It's not like an 80%, 90% – it's a 100% thing. We'll be there in 2027 for sure."

## Setting Expectations Amidst History

This strong declaration is crucial given the franchise's past. The thirteen-year gap between **Kingdom Hearts 2** and **Kingdom Hearts 3** remains a significant point of reference for many players. With eight years already passed since **Kingdom Hearts 3** arrived in 2019, the specter of another prolonged wait is understandable. However, the development team, including **Nana Gadd**, Director of Product Development at Disney and Pixar Games, appears determined to break that cycle. Their commitment to the late 2027 window suggests a smooth development process and a clear roadmap ahead, potentially signaling a new era for the series' release cadence as they look towards future anniversaries.

## Fan Reaction and Looking Ahead

For the passionate **Kingdom Hearts** community, this news is a welcome reassurance. While the series has a history of long development times, the explicit promises from **Nomura** and **Yasue** aim to quell anxieties and build anticipation. The developers' confidence, coupled with the recent start of the game's marketing campaign, indicates that players can expect a steady stream of updates leading up to the late 2027 release. The team is clearly focused not just on delivering **Kingdom Hearts 4**, but also on planning for the franchise's future, with **Nomura** mentioning preparations for the 30th anniversary.

## What's Next

Fans can now look forward to more marketing materials and gameplay reveals as the late 2027 launch window approaches. The developers have made it clear that **Kingdom Hearts 4** is their priority, and the current schedule is firm.

content_raw: Kingdom Hearts 4 co-director Tai Yasue and series creator Tetsuya Nomura have assured fans that it is a "100% thing" the game will not be delayed past its late 2027 launch window. While the team behind the new Kingdom Hearts game stopped short of sharing a final release date during its big D23 2026 presence, they feel pretty confident the current schedule will stick. Yasue, Nomura, and director of product development at Disney and Pixar games Nana Gadd doubled down on Square Enix's Kingdom Hearts 4 launch plans during a panel at this year's show. "One last thing I wanted to share: We announced the game is going to be coming in late 2027," Nomura said. "I saw online that some people were saying the release date might still get pushed back. I want to set the record straight: That is not happening. I do hope that people do look forward to the game coming in 2027. A lot of the marketing for the game has only just started, and so I do hope that people also look forward to hearing more news as well." "There's many things underway, many plans we have underway," he continued. "Now that we are approaching the 25th anniversary, we're thinking about what the 30th anniversary [looks like]." "I can confidently say and promise that it will launch in 2027," Yasue said. "Schedule-wise, the development is very smooth. It's not like an 80%, 90% – it's a 100% thing. We'll be there in 2027 for sure." The more skeptical fans believe they have some justification for their delay fears. Mainline entries in the series have suffered infamously long breaks between entries, with the break between Kingdom Hearts 2 and 3 being 13 years. We're now going on eight years since the last game's launch in 2019, but it sounds like the developers at Square Enix are confident the wait won't be too much longer. Another reason fans are worried about a delay relates to the recent conversation surrounding physical game discs. Sony announced in July that it will no longer support physical releases for new PlayStation games that launch after January 2028. Should Kingdom Hearts 4 be delayed past that date, it would make it the first mainline entry in the series without a physical release, at least on PlayStation 5. For now, however, Square Enix has yet to confirm any other details surrounding its launch. Kingdom Hearts 4 was formally announced in 2022 and will launch for PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox Series X | S in late 2027. While we wait to see what other Disney worlds and, hopefully, Final Fantasy characters the team have planned for the fourth games, you can read about the the extended gameplay trailer shown during the panel.
